subject: Onboarding orchestration checkpoints and SLA commitments
messages:
From: Daniel Kim <daniel.kim@familycare.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alyssa Tran <alyssa.tran@familycare.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Onboarding orchestration checkpoints and SLA commitments

Hi Michael —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. The exec team liked the latency/cost profile but they asked for a clear mutual action plan (MAP) and an onboarding timeline that ties milestones to owners and target dates so procurement and IT can line up resources.

High-level asks from our side:
- A week-by-week implementation timeline for the first 8 weeks
- Milestone owners (Redwood vs FamilyCare) and acceptance criteria
- SLA items (uptime, latency SLO targets, credits) we should expect in the Dedicated contract
- Any procurement pre-reqs (po, security questionnaire turnarounds, cert uploads) and expected lead times

Can you share a draft MAP and a short timeline this week? We have a procurement gate on 12/20 and would like a go/no-go meeting by 12/22.

Thanks,
Daniel
Daniel Kim
Director, Platform Engineering
FamilyCare Health

From: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>
To: Daniel Kim <daniel.kim@familycare.com>
Cc: Alyssa Tran <alyssa.tran@familycare.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 11 Dec 2026 11:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Onboarding orchestration checkpoints and SLA commitments

Daniel —

Appreciate the clear asks. Monica and I will own the MAP and delivery milestones; Ben (sales) and Laura (solutions) looped in for procurement and integration questions.

Immediate plan:
1) I will upload a draft MAP (week-by-week timeline + owners + acceptance criteria) to the shared Drive by EOD Monday (link below).
2) Monica will propose the recommended go-live window and staging/canary cadence; she will also attach a first-pass risk register.
3) Ben will outline procurement timeline and draft SLA language (credits/targets) for legal to review before 12/20.

Quick ask: can you confirm the internal FamilyCare stakeholders who must approve the SOW/procurement package (names & roles)? That will help us set approver owners in the MAP.

Shared doc (draft will be editable): https://drive.redwood.com/FamilyCare/MAP_v1

Regards,
Michael Grant
Head of Customer Success — North America
Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Daniel Kim <daniel.kim@familycare.com>, Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alyssa Tran <alyssa.tran@familycare.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 08:36:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Onboarding orchestration checkpoints and SLA commitments

Daniel / Team —

Attached is our first draft MAP (FamilyCare_MAP_v1.xlsx) and an SLA summary (SLA_Draft_FamilyCare.pdf). Highlights and proposed owners below. I kept items tight to meet your 12/20 procurement gate.

Week 0 (prep): 12/21–12/23- Redwoods: Legal (contract template) — Ben Carter- FamilyCare: Procurement approval & PO intake — Daniel Kim- Acceptance: PO submitted or formal procurement timeline documented

Week 1 (staging): 12/27–1/02- Redwoods: Infra provisioning (dedicated pool setup), credentials & KMS handoff — Laura Bennett- FamilyCare: Network allowlist & firewall rules — Alyssa Tran- Acceptance: test endpoint reachable from FamilyCare test subnet; smoke test pass

Week 2–3 (integration): 1/03–1/16- Redwoods: Integration support, model pinning advice, initial throughput tuning — Monica Patel- FamilyCare: App integration tests, telemetry hooks, auth validation — Daniel Kim- Acceptance: end-to-end test suite green (defined 6 tests in sheet)

Week 4 (canary): 1/17–1/23- Redwoods: Canary traffic routing, monitoring playbook — Monica Patel- FamilyCare: Incremental traffic enablement (5% → 25%) — Engineering Lead (TBD)- Acceptance: latency & error-rate SLOs met for 72 hours

Week 5 (ramp): 1/24–1/30- Redwoods: Autoscaling config & cost guardrails — Laura Bennett- FamilyCare: Ops runbook sign-off — Daniel Kim- Acceptance: steady-state throughput at target QPS

Week 6 (go-live): 1/31–2/06- Redwoods: Go-live support bridge — Monica Patel, Michael Grant- FamilyCare: Full cutover owner — Engineering Lead (TBD)- Acceptance: production traffic at target, post-cutover checklist complete

Risks flagged in the sheet: network ACL delays, cert rotation lead time, SOC2 evidence turnaround. I left a column for FamilyCare approvers.

Attachments (stubs):
- FamilyCare_MAP_v1.xlsx (sheet: timeline, owners, acceptance criteria, risks)
- SLA_Draft_FamilyCare.pdf (summary of SLOs and proposed credit language)

Questions:
- Who is the engineering lead that will own the canary/ramp decisions?
- Any blackout dates in Jan we should avoid for cutover?

I'll be available for a 30-min walkthrough tomorrow at 10am PT if helpful.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Daniel Kim <daniel.kim@familycare.com>, Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Onboarding orchestration checkpoints and SLA commitments

Daniel —

Quick fiscal/procurement notes:
- Standard procurement timeline for Dedicated: 5–7 business days for PO + legal turnaround if we use the Redwood redlines; add 3–5 more days if your legal requests material changes.
- Proposed SLA: 99.95% uptime target for Dedicated with a credit ladder starting at 99.90%. I attached the summary.
- If you need an executive credit note for procurement approval, I can prep a one-page exhibit.

Happy to sync with your procurement lead; please share contact details and the earliest slot for a short call.

–Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Alyssa Tran <alyssa.tran@familycare.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Daniel Kim <daniel.kim@familycare.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 16:48:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Onboarding orchestration checkpoints and SLA commitments

Michael / Team —

Thanks for the prompt draft. Confirming approvers:
- Daniel Kim (Director, Platform Eng) — technical sign-off- Priya Shah (Procurement Manager) — PO and commercial sign-off- Omar Ruiz (Security Lead) — security evidence & cert sign-off

We can target the Week 1 staging window (12/27–1/02) but would prefer the canary to start 01/20 instead of 01/17 due to a planned maintenance window on 01/16–01/18.

Priya is available for a procurement call tomorrow 12/15 at 9:30am PT; I will add her to the thread if that works for Redwood.

Alyssa Tran
Senior Network Engineer
FamilyCare Health
